name: How does a bonus room differ from a master suite addition?
description: A bonus room is a flexible, multi-purpose space, while a master suite addition is a dedicated primary bedroom with an attached bathroom and often a closet.

mainEntity.name: How does a bonus room differ from a master suite addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: A bonus room is typically designed as a flexible, multi-purpose space without an inherent predefined function, such as a home gym or media room. In contrast, a master suite addition is specifically designed to be a primary bedroom, usually incorporating a dedicated bathroom and sometimes a walk-in closet. While both are additions, the master suite has a clear residential function, whereas the bonus room emphasizes adaptability. Our team can help you determine which type best suits your needs and property in communities such as Marin County.
